title: Signs and Notices
description: Read the sign or notice and choose the correct meaning.

questions.sign_text: A standard circular prohibition sign with a thick red border and diagonal slash over a black camera icon with a flash on a plain white background, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO inner border box, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Visitors can borrow cameras from the studio media room now.
Please buy camera batteries at the studio reception office.
Taking pictures with cameras is allowed in the studio room.
Flash photography is not permitted in the live studio room.
questions.correct_answer: Flash photography is not permitted in the live studio room.

questions.sign_text: A standard circular prohibition sign with a thick red border and diagonal slash over a black smartphone icon displaying sound waves on a plain white background, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO inner border box, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Staff members can use mobile phones anywhere inside.
You must not use your mobile phone during recording.
Free phone chargers are provided inside this studio.
Please answer all mobile phone calls in the hallway.
questions.correct_answer: You must not use your mobile phone during recording.

questions.sign_text: A circular mandatory action sign with a deep blue background and a crisp white symbol of over-ear studio headphones centered, filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO inner border box, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Do not touch any headphones in this TV sound room.
You can buy stereo headphones in this studio shop.
You must wear audio headphones in this sound room.
Please return headphones to the main control desk.
questions.correct_answer: You must wear audio headphones in this sound room.

questions.sign_text: A triangular hazard warning sign with a bold yellow background, thick black triangular border, and a black symbol of a tripping figure over tangled electric cables, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO inner border box, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: You must not bring any cables onto this stage.
Electric cables are on sale in the media room.
Watch out for loose cables on the stage floor.
Studio workers will repair all damaged cables.
questions.correct_answer: Watch out for loose cables on the stage floor.

questions.sign_text: A triangular warning hazard sign with a bright yellow background, bold black border, and a black silhouette symbol of heavy stage lights falling from above, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO outer border frame, NO inner border box, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: Be careful because stage lights hang overhead.
Stage lights are not allowed inside this room.
Please turn off all bright stage lights today.
You can buy spare stage lights in this studio.
questions.correct_answer: Be careful because stage lights hang overhead.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, showing a studio door warning sign with a glowing red illuminated box that says 'ON AIR - RECORDING IN PROGRESS' with text below: 'Do Not Enter When Lit', sleek metallic and illuminated texture, large bold typography.
questions.question: What does the sign tell us?
options: Recording is active, so you must not enter.
You should turn on the studio lights today.
Visitors can enter the studio to watch now.
The TV studio is open for all visitors now.
questions.correct_answer: Recording is active, so you must not enter.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, showing a yellow sticky note texture with realistic handwritten text: 'Minh, our favourite cartoon starts at 5:30 p.m. on Channel 7. Please record it because I have extra maths class! - Duy', clear legible handwriting.
questions.question: What does the note say?
options: Minh and Duy will watch television at five now.
Minh should record the cartoon for Duy at home.
Duy wants Minh to attend the maths class today.
The cartoon on Channel 7 is cancelled tonight.
questions.correct_answer: Minh should record the cartoon for Duy at home.

questions.sign_text:
Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, showing an email client interface card with clean typography: 'From: Media Club <media@school.edu>
To: Grade 6 Students
Subject: Auditions for Student News Host
Date: Thursday, 3 PM
Room: Studio B
Prepare a 1-minute speech about your favourite school activity.'
questions.question: What does the email say?
options: The media club meeting moves to next week.
Grade 6 students must write a long report.
Studio B is closed for students this week.
Students can audition to host school news.
questions.correct_answer: Students can audition to host school news.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, showing a modern advertisement poster: 'KIDS TV STREAM - Annual Subscription Special! Pay for 6 months and get 6 months FREE! Unlimited access to 50+ educational channels and cartoons. Offer ends Sunday!'
questions.question: What does the notice tell us?
options: All educational TV channels are free forever.
Only fifty lucky children can join this week.
You pay for six months and get one full year.
The subscription discount ends in two months.
questions.correct_answer: You pay for six months and get one full year.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, showing an event flyer poster: 'Junior TV Quiz Championship! Teams of 3 students. Date: Saturday, October 15 at 9:00 AM. Venue: Main School Auditorium. Grand Prize: School Trip to National TV Station! Free entry for all students.'
questions.question: What does the flyer tell us?
options: The winners will get free tickets to the cinema.
Only individual players can enter this quiz now.
The quiz takes place at the national TV station.
Teams of three students can enter the quiz free.
questions.correct_answer: Teams of three students can enter the quiz free.
